LanguageData.BO_CreepDesc: Drag a rectangle from the starting edge. The selected guns advance across it in groups. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the drag.
LanguageData.BO_CircleDesc: Drag from the centre to set the radius. The selected guns share one finite order across the filled circle. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the drag.
LanguageData.BO_StopDesc: Remove selected guns from their barrage. Other participants take over the remaining area.
LanguageData.BO_RectHint: Drag from the starting edge. Release to order.
LanguageData.BO_CircleHint: Drag from the centre to the rim. Release to order.
LanguageData.BO_Order: Barrage ordered. Estimated {0} rounds across {1} guns, covering {2}/{3} cells. Actual impacts follow normal game scatter.
LanguageData.BO_Progress: Barrage rounds fired by this gun: {0}. Estimated remaining: {1}.
LanguageData.BO_Waiting: Barrage area recorded. Waiting for a known projectile.
LanguageData.BO_OnHold: Waiting for hold fire to be released.
LanguageData.BO_NeedsCrew: Waiting for a gunner or an active turret.
LanguageData.BO_NoReach: The selected guns cannot designate an aim cell in this area.
LanguageData.BO_Skipped: Barrage finished with {0} cells out of reach.
